standards.name: 90 Percent Coverage for Critical Paths
test: Open the quality gate settings in SonarQube and verify a 90% coverage condition is enforced for designated critical modules.
Open the latest scan in SonarQube and confirm each critical module (rating, claims payment, commission, reporting) is at 90%+.
Open the coverage config file in the repository on GitHub Enterprise and confirm all critical financial modules are listed.
Check the critical-module register's last review date in GitHub Enterprise and confirm it falls within the past quarter.
Find a recent run in GitHub Actions where a critical module fell below 90% and confirm the gate failed and blocked promotion.
Pass when every designated critical module shows 90% or higher coverage and below-threshold builds are blocked.

standards.name: ADRs Required for Significant Decisions
test: Export the list of architecturally significant decisions for the review period from the epic list in Jira.
Open the ADR directory in the repository on GitHub Enterprise and match each decision to an ADR dated before implementation.
Open a sample of five ADRs in GitHub Enterprise and confirm Context, Options Considered, Decision, and Consequences are filled.
Confirm each sampled ADR in GitHub Enterprise carries status Accepted or Superseded rather than Draft.
Cross-check architecture review minutes in Confluence against the ADR index and flag any initiative lacking an ADR.
Open the file history of one accepted ADR in GitHub Enterprise and confirm edits appear as traceable commits.
Pass when every significant decision has a complete accepted ADR dated before its implementation.

standards.name: API Keys for Partners
test: Export the API key registry from the API gateway and confirm no key value is shared across distinct partner organizations.
Open the onboarding tickets for three partners in ServiceNow ITSM and confirm each key links to an approved onboarding request.
Query the API gateway for keys not rotated within the defined schedule (e.g. 90 days), target zero overdue keys.
Call a partner-scoped endpoint through the API gateway with a revoked test key and confirm HTTP 401 with no data returned.
Pass when no key is shared across organizations, zero keys are overdue for rotation, and revoked keys are rejected with 401.

standards.name: ARB Approval Required for Major Initiatives
test: Export the initiative intake register for the review period from the PPM tool (Clarity/Planview).
Filter the register in the PPM tool by the cost, risk, and cross-domain thresholds to list all ARB-required initiatives.
Open each qualifying initiative's architecture package in Confluence and confirm all mandatory template sections are present.
Open the ARB decision log in Confluence and confirm each initiative has an explicit decision dated before its funding gate.
For one conditionally approved initiative, confirm in Confluence that all conditions were closed before implementation began.
Pass when every qualifying initiative shows an explicit ARB decision recorded before its funding gate was passed.

standards.name: Acceptance Criteria
test: Run a filter in Jira for stories from the most recent two sprints and randomly sample ten.
Open each sampled story in Jira and confirm the acceptance criteria section is populated.
Open each story's history tab in Jira and confirm the criteria were entered before the sprint planning ceremony.
Review each criterion in Jira for observable Given/When/Then style wording and flag any that cannot be objectively tested.
Confirm the product owner's approval or assignment appears on each story in Jira at or before the sprint start timestamp.
Pass when all ten sampled stories carry testable acceptance criteria entered and agreed before sprint planning.

standards.name: Accepted
test: Filter completed stories from the last two sprints in Jira and confirm each shows a formal Accepted status transition.
Open the history of each story in Jira and record the actor and timestamp of the Accepted transition.
For three sampled stories, compare the acceptance timestamp in Jira against the sprint review date on the team page in Confluence.
Search Jira for Accepted stories later reopened or carried into a later sprint under the same ID, target zero.
Pass when every completed story shows an Accepted transition after sprint review and zero post-acceptance reopens.

standards.name: Accountability Documented
test: Open the role charter library in Confluence and list every active data owner and data steward charter.
Confirm each charter in Confluence is signed and lists access approval, quality remediation, classification, and glossary duties.
Open five datasets holding policyholder PII in the enterprise data catalog and confirm each has a named owner and steward.
Cross-check the five named owners and stewards against current employees in the HR system.
Search Jira for duty-discharge tickets from the last 12 months covering at least two of the four duties per owner and steward.
Pass when every active owner and steward has a signed charter and 12-month evidence covering at least two duties.

standards.name: Actionable Alerts
test: Export the full alert ruleset from the alerting platform (PagerDuty).
Review each rule in the PagerDuty export and flag any lacking a failing-component name or an impacted audience statement.
Pull the prior 30 days of incidents in PagerDuty and list alerts fired three or more times without a linked remediation action.
Open the runbook index in Confluence and confirm every active alert maps to a runbook with at least one prescribed human action.
Pass when no alert lacks a component and audience description or a runbook and all repeat-firing alerts are tuned or retired.

standards.name: Addressed Within Two Sprints
test: Export the technical-debt backlog from Jira and filter for items created more than two sprints ago.
Confirm each filtered item in Jira is resolved or carries an explicit deferral decision recorded on the item.
For a random sample of five closed debt items in Jira, compare the sprint raised against the sprint resolved.
For any item exceeding two sprints, open the item in Jira and confirm a deferral note with team lead name, date, and reason.
Pass when every debt item is resolved within two sprints or carries a recorded team lead deferral decision.

standards.name: Alert Fatigue Monitored
test: Export the last four weeks of paging data from the on-call platform (PagerDuty).
Open the analytics view in PagerDuty and confirm weekly paging volume, after-hours count, and actionable ratio are current.
Open the last two operational meeting minutes in Confluence and confirm alert-fatigue metrics were reviewed with actions noted.
List in PagerDuty analytics any week in the past 60 days where the non-actionable ratio exceeded the threshold (or 20%).
Search Jira for a tuning ticket raised within one sprint of each breach week.
Pass when the three metrics are current, reviewed in both cycles, and every breach triggered a tuning ticket within one sprint.

standards.name: All Capabilities Exposed via Well-Defined APIs
test: List the business capabilities delivered in the past two release cycles from the release log in Jira.
Open each capability's OpenAPI spec history in GitHub Enterprise and confirm the spec commit predates the first code merge.
Attempt to reach each capability via its private database connection from outside its service and confirm access is refused.
Open the API catalog in the API gateway and confirm every capability has a semver version, description, and consumer contract.
Open three recent consumer-onboarding changes in Jira and confirm each consumed the published API with no new database link.
Pass when every capability sits in the catalog behind a versioned spec authored before implementation with no side-door access.

standards.name: All Datasets Registered
test: Export the full dataset inventory from the enterprise data catalog.
Run an inventory query against the warehouse, lake, and analytical stores and diff the result against the catalog export.
Open the deployment pipeline config in GitHub Actions and confirm a catalog-registration step gates promotion to production.
Sample ten datasets registered in the past 90 days in the data catalog and confirm description, owner, and source are populated.
Cross-check the ten dataset owners against the current data stewardship roster in Confluence.
Pass when 100% of discovered datasets are registered with complete fields and the pipeline blocks unregistered promotions.

standards.name: All Regression Automated
test: Open each team's pipeline config in GitHub Actions and confirm the full regression suite is a mandatory non-skippable stage.
Open the regression inventory in Jira and confirm rating, policy lifecycle, and claims scenarios have no manual-only cases.
Open the last three release runs in GitHub Actions and confirm each shows a passing automated regression stage.
Check release records in Jira for the same three releases and confirm no manual regression sign-off replaced automation.
Trigger a test pipeline run in GitHub Actions with the regression stage skipped and confirm promotion is blocked.
Pass when the last three releases ran passing automated regression and builds with a skipped stage cannot be promoted.

standards.name: All Security Risks Documented in Enterprise Risk Register
test: Export the enterprise risk register filtered to security risks for the last 12 months from ServiceNow ITSM.
Confirm each register entry in ServiceNow ITSM shows owner, inherent and residual ratings, treatment plan, and status.
Sample five risks across two or more source types in ServiceNow ITSM and compare taxonomy and scoring to non-security risks.
Trace each sampled risk to its source ticket in ServiceNow ITSM and confirm the register entry was created within the SLA.
Open the latest risk committee package in Confluence and confirm security risks appear in the aggregate heat map.
Pass when all 12-month security risks are registered with complete fields on the shared taxonomy and scoring scales.

standards.name: Allocation Visibility
test: Export the current-week allocation report from the PPM tool (Clarity/Planview).
Confirm every active delivery resource in the PPM tool shows named project assignments, committed percentages, and date ranges.
Review the PPM tool report for resources with unaccounted time gaps between assignments, target zero.
Survey three delivery managers and their supplying managers and cross-check stated allocations against the PPM tool records.
Review recent project kick-off documents in Confluence for resources absent from the PPM tool, flag each as a control failure.
Pass when 100% of active delivery resources have current allocations in the system and no off-system commitments are found.

standards.name: Annual Review
test: Open the latest annual ownership-review record in Confluence and confirm it is signed and dated within the last 365 days.
Confirm the review in Confluence lists every data owner and steward with a reconfirmed or reassigned outcome.
Compare the roster against leavers and movers in the HR system and confirm reassignments within 30 days of each change.
Pull recertification logs from the IAM system and confirm each owner and steward completed at least one action in the period.
Ask three sampled data owners for a recent duty action in each charter area and verify each record in the IAM system.
Pass when the review is complete within 12 months, no orphaned assignments remain, and all recertifications are evidenced.

standards.name: Approved Patterns Documented With Examples
test: Open the architecture pattern library in Confluence and list all reference patterns with version and last-reviewed date.
Confirm each pattern page in Confluence contains intended context, component diagram, technology choices, and a worked example.
Flag any pattern in Confluence whose last-reviewed date exceeds the review interval (e.g. twelve months).
Cross-check two active patterns' technology choices against the approved technology radar in Confluence.
Open the page history of one pattern in Confluence and confirm changes create versioned records with change descriptions.
Pass when every pattern is complete, versioned, reviewed on schedule, and references only currently approved platforms.

standards.name: Architecture Decision Records for Decisions
test: Open the docs/adr directory of each in-scope repository in GitHub Enterprise and list all ADR files with commit dates.
Confirm ADRs exist in GitHub Enterprise for all significant decisions of the past 12 months, including platform selections.
Open three random ADRs in GitHub Enterprise and confirm context, options weighed, decision, and consequences are all filled.
For the most recent material architecture change, compare its ADR commit date in GitHub Enterprise to the merge date on main.
Pass when all significant decisions have complete ADRs committed at or before the corresponding change merge.
